description: A bearded man in profile stands in a dim stone hall, lifting one foot onto a wooden chest. He wears a long dark brocade robe trimmed with fur and gold embroidery, a chain collar, a belt with a hanging pouch, black hose, and long curled-tip shoes. A tall arched window throws a shaft of light across the flagstones, with a stone pillar, a tapestry on the left and an iron candle stand on the right. No text, frame or border is visible; the painting runs edge to edge. Late medieval costume, no violence or nudity.
